clues.it: Irene era nella 10ª colonna e nella 1ª riga, ma non era accanto a un grammofono.
clues.en: Irene was in the 10th column and in the 1st row, but was not beside a gramophone.

clues.it: Marta era accanto a un baule da viaggio e in una stanza diversa da Elena.
clues.en: Marta was beside a steamer trunk and in a different room from Elena.

clues.it: Anna era nella 6ª colonna, nella 3ª riga e a nord di Elena.
clues.en: Anna was in the 6th column, in the 3rd row and north of Elena.

clues.it: Luca era nella 2ª colonna e nella 4ª riga, ma non era accanto a il bancone della reception.
clues.en: Luca was in the 2nd column and in the 4th row, but was not beside the reception desk.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 3ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e a ovest di Elena.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 3rd column, in the 5th row and west of Elena.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Elena era nella 4ª colonna e accanto a dei bicchieri rotti, ma non era accanto a una poltrona di velluto.
clues.en: Elena was in the 4th column and beside broken glasses, but was not beside a velvet armchair.

clues.it: Ugo era in una stanza diversa da Bruno e nella Sala da Ballo.
clues.en: Ugo was in a different room from Bruno and in the Ballroom.

clues.it: Nino era nella 5ª colonna e accanto a un pianoforte a coda.
clues.en: Nino was in the 5th column and beside a grand piano.

clues.it: Rosa era accanto a un tappeto persiano, ma non era accanto a un tavolo da biliardo.
clues.en: Rosa was beside a persian carpet, but was not beside a billiard table.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Irene lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Irene's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 10th.

steps.it: Bruno può stare solo nella 5ª riga: escludendola, a Marta resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Bruno can only be in the 5th row: ruling it out leaves Marta a single square: row 2nd, column 7th.

steps.en: Nino can only be in the 9th row: ruling it out leaves Rosa a single square: row 10th, column 9th.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 8ª colonna, e lì a Ugo resta una sola casella libera: la 8ª riga.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 8th column, and it leaves Ugo a single free square there: the 8th row.
